title: Update 23.5 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 23.5 for Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2 introduces hotfixes, localization updates for Norway and Mexico, improved administration roles, and upcoming features becoming mandatory. Use this page to learn what changed in this minor update and prepare for upcoming feature transitions.
